thread:
sam (Design): quick check 1: compact teams form: do we prefer inline row errors or a single top error summary when pasting many rows? also debating whether to require typed confirm for bulk removes >20. thoughts?
harper (PM): prefer inline errors for fast edit cycles, but top summary useful when many rows fail. maybe both: summary + inline anchors.
lee (Eng): inline is fine; avoid layout shift by reserving error height. anchors from summary -> row id for keyboard users. typed confirm: easy server-side, but mobile keyboard covers CTA.
jo (A11y): accessibility notes: 1) asterisk alone isn't accessible 1: include sr-only "required" for screen readers. 2) error summary should be role="alert" and focusable. 3) if using typed confirm, announce "Step 2 of 2" via aria-live.
ops-bot: telemetry: emit bulk_paste, bulk_error_count, bulk_confirm_attempt, bulk_confirm_success, bulk_undo_used. include affected_count and device_type.
harper (PM): proposal: default = inline errors + top summary; typed confirm for >=20 rows or org toggle; undo toast 2m default, org-configurable. A/B test for 4 weeks.
sam (Design): i'll update mocks with both patterns and microcopy. lee, can you estimate? jo will run a11y quick pass.
lee (Eng): yes, estimate coming. note: debounce paste validation and server-side double-check. avoid autofocus on iOS.
jo (A11y): will run quick pass and add ARIA snippets.
sam (Design): great, scheduling 20min follow-up tomorrow. :thumbsup:
